IsConjSelfDual.name: IsConjSelfDual
IsConjSelfDual.statement:
structure IsConjSelfDual {D : Data P} {n} [Fintype n] t (R : GalRep ℓ D.E n) where
  continuous : Continuous R
  nondeg : IsTraceNondeg R
  trace_conj g : (R (conjGal g)).1.trace = cycInv ℓ _ _ g ^ (t - 1) * (R g⁻¹).1.trace

crudeUnit.name: crudeUnit
crudeUnit.statement: def crudeUnit (ℓ : ℕ) {P} (D : Data P) : NNReal := padicValNat ℓ D.chosenGroupOrder + (1 / 2) ^ ℓ

SelmerLengthLe.name: SelmerLengthLe
SelmerLengthLe.statement:
def SelmerLengthLe Q m γ (z : intQpBar ℓ) := ∀ᶠ O : CoeffRing ℓ in .atTop, ∃ u ψ' y, y.1 = ↑z ∧
  IsLatticeIn R u ∧ (∀ g, ψ' g = ψ g) ∧ let ρ := twistRep (.id O) ψ' u; ρ γ = (y : ↑O) • 1 ∧
    IsUnit (y - 1) ∧ cycChar Ω ℓ γ = 1 ∧ O.normLength (Module.length O ↥(selmerModule ρ
    (placesDividing _ ℓ ∪ placesAboveG D ∪ .conjClosure Q) (crysRels ρ) (QuotSpan (ℓ ^ m : ↑O)) ⊓
    (LinearMap.proj γ).ker)) ≤ 10 * D.f * Fintype.card n * crudeUnit ℓ D + crudeUnit ℓ D

IsColumn.name: IsColumn
IsColumn.statement:
structure IsColumn extends IsConjSelfDual t R where
  local_conditions : ∀ v ∉ S \ (placesDividing _ ℓ ∪ placesAboveG D), ∀ ⦃A : ClosurePlace⦄,
    IsPlaceOver A v → IsFiniteTypeAt R A ∧ HasJumpsAt R A J ∧ (v ∉ placesAboveG D → IsGoodAt R A)

IsRow.name: IsRow
IsRow.statement:
structure IsRow extends IsColumn D t J ∅ R, IsRowType D (Fintype.card n) t J where
  inertia_above_g : ∀ v ∈ placesAboveG D \ placesDividing _ ℓ,
    ∀ ⦃A : ClosurePlace⦄ (h : IsPlaceOver A v), ∃ γ N, (D.IsChosen v → γ = h.tameGenerator) ∧
    A.valuation N.cast = 1 ∧ (∀ i ∈ inertiaGroup _ A, R (i ^ N) = 1) ∧
    ∀ b, ellVal ((R (idOrConjInv b γ)).1 - 1).det ≤ Fintype.card n * crudeUnit ℓ D
  span_and_scalar : ∀ᶠ O in .atTop, ∀ u, IsLatticeIn (O := O) R u → Submodule.span O
    (.range u) = ⊤ ∧ ∃ g i α, (cycChar Ω ℓ g).1 = D.g i ^ Fintype.card n ∧ u g = (α : ↑O) • 1
  exists_scalar_inertia : ∃ᵉ (γ ∈ inertiaAbove (placesAboveG D \ placesDividing _ ℓ)) (y :
    PadicAlgCl ℓ), (R γ).1 = y • 1 ∧
    ∀ᵉ (a) (j ∈ Set.Icc 1 (4 * Fintype.card n + 2)), ‖(y ^ ℓ ^ a) ^ j - 1‖ = 1

normalisedRep.name: normalisedRep
normalisedRep.statement: abbrev normalisedRep := twistByChar (m := n) (chiOneInv O) R

IsApt.name: IsApt
IsApt.statement:
structure IsApt (ϑ : D.Twist) where
  toLevelPlaces_eq : O.toLevelPlaces = D.levelPlaces ϑ
  tame_part_eq : ∃ j ∈ Icc 1 D.m, O.ψ = D.ω ^ (j : ℤ) * ϑ.ψ
  odd : Odd (card r) ∧ Odd O.rankDiff
  rank_le : card r ≤ D.r ∧ O.rankDiff ≤ D.t
  isLabel i : IsLabel (card r) (c i)
  exists_primitive k : ∃ i, ↑(D.g k) ∈ (O.chosenPlace i).1 ∧
    (card r = D.r ∧ IsPrimitiveLabel (card r) (c i) ∨ card r = 1 ∧ c i = X - 1)
  isLabel_twistedLabel i : ¬(twistedLabel O c i).IsRoot 1

HasRow.name: HasRow
HasRow.statement:
def HasRow := (∃ τ, IsRow (n := r) D O.rankDiff τ R) ∧ ∀ {ϑ : D.TameChar} {V : AuxPair _ r n} {y H
  S}, V.μ = O.μ * ϑ.toAutChar → V.Lifts y z → IsEigenform y H → Attached H S → ∀ g, (normalisedRep V
  S g).1.trace = ϑ.invAvatar g * (R g).1.trace + ∑ e ∈ .range V.rankDiff, cycInv ℓ _ _ g ^ e

IsLabelledColumn.name: IsLabelledColumn
IsLabelledColumn.statement:
structure IsLabelledColumn extends IsColumn (n := m) D k J S R where
  labelled ⦃i A⦄ : IsLabelledAt A (faithfulChar (ResField (O.chosenPlace i))) (card r).factorial
    (PolyKillsAt R A) (c i)

obeyingCocycles.name: obeyingCocycles
obeyingCocycles.statement:
def obeyingCocycles (a : O) := obeying (cocycleRels ρ) (QuotSpan a) ⊓
  ⨅ θ ∈ (linearCombination O fun g ↦ (u · g - 1)).ker, ((bilinearCombination O O).flip θ).ker

RowBlockIndex.statement: def RowBlockIndex (r : Type) {t} : Option (Fin t) → Type | none => r | _ => Unit

IsAuxiliary.statement: @[grind] def IsAuxiliary := ∀ v ∈ I', v ∉ S ∧ v.q.Prime ∧ star v ∉ I' ∧ star v ∉ S

evenClasses.name: evenClasses

IsNewPlaces.name: IsNewPlaces
IsNewPlaces.statement:
def IsNewPlaces (w : J → FinPlace E) (τ φ : J → Gal(Ω/E)) := ∀ j, w j ∉ placesDividing E ℓ ∧
  cycCharMod Ω (ℓ ^ ν) (φ j) = 1 ∧ ∃ A, ∃ h : IsPlaceOver A (w j), h.tameGenerator = τ j

withConjInv.name: withConjInv
withConjInv.statement: noncomputable abbrev withConjInv (k : J × _) := idOrConjInv k.2 (τ k.1)

IsPrimeTriangle.name: IsPrimeTriangle
IsPrimeTriangle.statement:
structure IsPrimeTriangle (w : J → FinPlace E) (τ φ : J → Gal(Ω/E)) (a : Gal(Ω/E)) [LinearOrder J]
  [Fintype J] (t) (ty : J →o {e : Fin t // 0 < e.1}) (h c) where
  isNewPlaces : IsNewPlaces ν w τ φ
  detect : ∃ s : Finset _, (card J + s.card) * h ≤ c ∧ ∀ (O : CoeffRing ℓ) e, ∀ z ∈ selmerModule
    (tateTwist ℓ E O e) (placesDividing E ℓ) ∅ (QuotSpan (ℓ ^ ν : ↑O)), (∀ g ∈ s, z g = 0) → z = 0
  prod_dvd (e : Fin t) : ∏ k ∈ {e}ᶜ, ((cycChar Ω ℓ a⁻¹ ^ e.1).1 - (cycChar Ω ℓ a⁻¹ ^ k.1).1) ∣ ℓ ^ h
  step O j : ∀ z ∈ evenClasses O (.range w) ν (ty j).1, (∀ i < j,
    z (τ i) = 0 ∧ ((ty i).1 = (ty j).1 → z (φ i) = 0)) → ℓ ^ h • z (τ j) = 0
  coboundary (O : CoeffRing ℓ) e : let d g := cycInv ℓ E O g ^ e.1.1 - 1
    2 ^ 2 * d a ^ 2 ∣ (ℓ ^ h : ↑O) ∧ ∀ z ∈ evenClasses O ∅ ν e.1, (∀ j, ty j = e → z (φ j) = 0) →
               ∀ g, d a • (z + z) g = d g • (z + z) a

IsAuxTwist.name: IsAuxTwist
IsAuxTwist.statement:
def IsAuxTwist (ψ : Gal(Ω/E) →* PadicAlgCl ℓ) c := IsAuxiliary S Q ∧ IsFromU1 (placesDividing E ℓ) Q
  ψ ∧ ∃ σ, IsNewPlaces 0 ((↑) : Q → _) σ 1 ∧ ∑ k, ellVal (ψ (σ k) - 1) ≤ c

existscycCharpowsubonedvd.name: exists_cycChar_pow_sub_one_dvd
existscycCharpowsubonedvd.statement:
lemma exists_cycChar_pow_sub_one_dvd {P} (D : Data P) ℓ [ThePrime ℓ] : ∃ h ≤ padicValNat ℓ
  D.chosenGroupOrder, (ℓ ≤ D.h₂ ^ 2 ∨ h = 0) ∧ ∃ γ : AbsGal D, ∀ a ∈ Set.Ioo 0 D.t, (cycChar Ω ℓ γ ^
  a).1 - 1 ∣ ℓ ^ h

denominatorLerowBudget.name: denominatorLe_rowBudget
denominatorLerowBudget.statement:
theorem denominatorLe_rowBudget {P} {D : Data P} {ℓ} [ThePrime ℓ] (ι : PadicIso ℓ) (ϑ :
  D.Twist) (hq : IsAuxTwist (badPlaces D ℓ) ϑ.Q ϑ.invAvatar (crudeUnit ℓ D)) {r n} [Fintype r]
  [Fintype n] {O : AuxPair _ r n} {E Z} (hw : Z ≤ span ℂ {y ∈ Z | (∃ c, y ∈ (tupleProj O c).range ∧
  IsApt O c ϑ ∧ (tupleProj O c).range ≤ range (O.groupAlgAction E)) ∧ ∃ z, O.Lifts y z ∧ ∃ R, ∃ V :
  AuxPair _ r n, HasRow V z R ∧ O.μ = V.μ * ϑ.toAutChar ∧ ∃ γ s, SelmerLengthLe ϑ.invAvatar R ϑ.Q
  (⌊D.r * rowBudget D ℓ⌋₊ + 1) γ s}) : DenominatorLe ιℓ O E Z (rowBudget D ℓ * log ℓ)

binders.name: hq
binders.type: IsAuxTwist (badPlaces D ℓ) ϑ.Q ϑ.invAvatar (crudeUnit ℓ D)

binders.name: hw
binders.type: Z ≤ span ℂ {y ∈ Z | (∃ c, y ∈ (tupleProj O c).range ∧ IsApt O c ϑ ∧ (tupleProj O c).range ≤ range (O.groupAlgAction E)) ∧ ∃ z, O.Lifts y z ∧ ∃ R, ∃ V : AuxPair _ r n, HasRow V z R ∧ O.μ = V.μ * ϑ.toAutChar ∧ ∃ γ s, SelmerLengthLe ϑ.invAvatar R ϑ.Q (⌊D.r * rowBudget D ℓ⌋₊ + 1) γ s}

crysRels.name: crysRels
crysRels.statement: def crysRels := ⋃ v, Finsupp.mapDomain Subtype.val '' relationsOn (ZfAt v u)

blockLoss.name: blockLoss
blockLoss.statement:
abbrev blockLoss {X σ} [Fintype σ] (w : X → Gal(Ω/E) →* Matrix σ σ O) (M : ℕ) := relLength
    (obeyingCocycles w u (ℓ ^ M)) (obeying (crysRels u) _)

cmSign.name: cmSign
cmSign.statement: def cmSign {E} [Field E] [c : PlaceEmbedding E] σ := ite (σ = c.1 (.mk σ)) 1 (-1 : ℤˣ)

IsRowType.name: IsRowType
IsRowType.statement:
structure IsRowType (r t) (J : _ → Multiset ℤ) where
  rank_mem : r ∈ Set.Icc 1 D.r
  t_le : t ≤ D.t
  low_or_high : ∃ j ≤ D.m, ∀ σ, ∀ u ∈ J σ,
    D.h₂ ≤ 2 * u.natAbs ∧ u.natAbs ≤ D.h₂ ^ 2 ∨ |cmSign σ * u + D.w j (.mk σ)| ≤ D.t
  card_low_le σ : (J σ).countP (·.natAbs ≤ 2 * D.h₂ ^ 2) * D.k ≤ r * D.m
  card_neg_le σ : (J σ).countP (· < 0) + (J (star σ)).countP (· < 0) ≤ r

lambdaLoss.name: lambdaLoss
lambdaLoss.statement:
@[irreducible] def lambdaLoss (h b l : ℕ) := padicValNat l
    ((2 * b).factorial * (∏ k ∈ .Ioc (b - 30 * h ^ 3) (b + 30 * h ^ 3), k) ^ h ^ 3)

loss.name: loss
loss.statement:
def loss (l : ℕ) :

innerAtheckePolyOnForms.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.innerAt_heckePolyOnForms
innerAtheckePolyOnForms.statement:
lemma LevelPlaces.LevelForm.innerAt_heckePolyOnForms {E r n} [Field E] [CMType E] [WeilData E]
  [Fintype r] [Fintype n] {O : AuxPair E r n} σ φ φ' {w} (hw : _ ≠ w) hS hS' X :

DenominatorLe.name: DenominatorLe
DenominatorLe.statement:
def DenominatorLe β := ∀ d, finrank ℂ Z = d → ∀ y y' : Fin d → _,
  (∀ a (j : PadicPlace ℓ), y a ∈ integralForms j) →
  (∀ b, y' b ∈ integralForms ⟨(algebraMap _ ℂ_[ℓ]).comp ι.toRingHom⟩ ∧ O.IsTested e₀ Zᗮ (y' b)) → ‖ι
  (of fun a b ↦ inner ℂ (y a) (Z.starProjection (y' b))).det‖ ≤ .exp (d * (Fintype.card r * β))

heckeAlgebra.name: Data.heckeAlgebra
heckeAlgebra.statement:
def Data.heckeAlgebra : Subalgebra ℂ (∀ {s} (V : Space _ _ s), End ℂ (D.principalForms V)) where
  carrier := {p | ∃ a, ∀ s V y, asAlgebraHom
    ((V.formRep _).comp (trivialOn _ (.range D.chosen)).subtype) a y.1 = @p s V y}
  mul_mem' | ⟨a, _⟩, ⟨b, _⟩ => ⟨a * b, by simp [*]⟩
  add_mem' | ⟨a, _⟩, ⟨b, _⟩ => ⟨a + b, by simp [*]⟩
  algebraMap_mem' := (⟨· • 1, by simp⟩)

heckeOperator.name: Data.heckeOperator
heckeOperator.statement:
noncomputable def Data.heckeOperator (x : FinPlace D.E × ℕ) : D.heckeAlgebra := if h :
  D.IsSplitOffLevel x.1 then ⟨fun _ ↦ .restrict _ fun _ m ↦ heckeSplit_mem_levelSpace h.1 x.2
  (levelSpace_anti (maxCompactAt_le_levelOf h.2) m) levelOf_le_Kf m, heckeGL ((leftRegular ℂ
  _).comp ((atSplit h.1).codRestrict _ (by grind [mem_trivialOn, atPlace_atSplit_of_ne, star_star,
  IsSplitOffLevel])))
  x.2 1, by simp [heckeSplit, heckeGL, heckeFun_sum, MonoidAlgebra.one_def]⟩ else 0

IsFitFamily.name: Data.IsFitFamily
IsFitFamily.statement:
structure Data.IsFitFamily (θ : PrimePadicIso → D.MFoldTwist) where
  coprime ι : Nat.Coprime ι.1.1 (θ ι).levelNorm
  denominator_le j : ∃ γ, (∀ T : Finset ℕ, (∀ l ∈ T, l.Prime) → T.sum γ ≤ D.B₀) ∧ ∀ ι, DenominatorLe
    ι.2 _ D.e₀ (D.goodLift ((θ ι).powTwist j) j).range (γ ι.1) ∧ ∀ p : D.Pair, ∀ H : p.IsRankOne j,
    DenominatorLe ι.2 _ (tupleIdem _ fun _ ↦
    .X - 1) (ℂ ∙ (p.lValueData H.1 ((θ ι).powTwist j)).trivialLift) (γ ι.1)
  height_le j (p : D.Pair) s : p.IsRamified → HeightLe (D.x ^ 999) fun ι ↦
    (p.ratio ((θ ι).powTwist j) s)⁻¹

    z (g * a * g⁻¹ * b) = cycCharMod Ω (ℓ ^ r) g ^ (e + 1) * z a + z b

    IsSplitPlace r (x j) ∧ primeBelowPlus (x j).w ∉ T) → ∀ j, (∀ i ≠ j, z (x i).frob = 0) → ∀ O,
    ∀ c ∈ evenClasses O (.range (x · |>.w)) r e,

    c (τ (i, false)) ∧ (i ∈ I → c (φ (i, true)) = c (φ (i, false)))) → C • c (τ (j, true)) =
    C • c (τ (j, false))) ∧ ∀ S ≤ Z ⊓ .pi L ⊥, (∀ c ∈ S, (∀ k, c (τ k) = 0) ∧ ∀ j ∈ I,
    c (φ (j, true)) = c (φ (j, false))) → relLength Z (.pi L ⊥) + relLength S (torsionBy O _ C) ≤ b
